typesense:trending.greeting:
*The world is dying.*

*Long ago, an ancient curse spread across the land, destroying forests, poisoning rivers and collapsing entire ecosystems. Kingdoms fell, cities became ruins and the old roads were abandoned.*

*There is no single kingdom anymore. No true empire controls the world. Scattered settlements, ruined cities, isolated clans, wandering armies and small communities struggle to survive among the remains of civilization.*

*Magic still exists, but the curse made it unstable. Spells can fail. Powerful magic can have dangerous consequences. Even the land itself can become hostile.*

**Welcome to the Hardcore Dark Fantasy Sandbox.**

*This world will not protect you.*

*You can be whoever you want: a warrior, mage, hunter, mercenary, thief, wanderer, noble survivor, healer, monster hunter, merchant—or simply someone trying to stay alive.*

*Food, money, shelter, equipment, information and even trust are valuable.*

*Everything has a cost.*

*Travel is dangerous. Monsters roam the ruins. People have their own ambitions. Injuries matter. Mistakes can be fatal. Not every problem can be solved by fighting.*

*There is no chosen path and no guaranteed destiny.*

*Your story begins wherever you choose.*
